title: Cebu faces more rain as ITCZ persists, raising flood risks

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Flood-prone communities in Metro Cebu face continued rain-related risks as the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) brings rain showers and thunderstorms to the Visayas, even as a monitored low-pressure area (LPA) remains outside the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR). The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) forecast cloudy skies with rain showers and thunderstorms over Metro Cebu and the rest of Cebu province on Friday, Oct. 9, with similar conditions expected in parts of the weekend outlook. Pagasa warned that occasional heavy rainfall could trigger flash floods or landslides, particularly in identified vulnerable areas. The forecast […]...
